info.title: Repo Manager external-agent API
info.description: Opt-in HTTPS on 11435. Native-scoped bearer clients. No existing-chat access, remote approval, vision/audio/embeddings/classifiers, shell or imported runtimes. Compatibility is a bounded subset; unknown options fail explicitly. All date numbers are Unix seconds. Native mutation review is required.

host.description: Use configured certificate hostname/IP; trust exported public certificate, never disable verification.
